opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The SLAO had passed the award dated 15.02.2011 fixing the market value of the property at Rs.40,000/- per acre.
On a reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 the Reference Court was enhanced the market value of the land to Rs.1,75,000/- per acre vide order dated 10.11.2015 in LAC No.11/2014.
On a further appeal for enhancement the Appellate Court by the impugned order dated 27.11.2018 passed in LACA No.78/2018 further enhanced the compensation amount to Rs.4,38,036/- per acre.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments: He submits Appellate Court instead of taking 5% de-escalation had taken only 3% de-escalation and that if compensation awarded by the Appellate Court is reduced by taking 5% de-escalation purpose of filing of the appeal would be served.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Since the order in MSA No.200101/2024 is passed in respect of the very same Notification dated 07.02.2009 in respect of the land which is situated in Jawali-D village, Aland Taluk, Kalaburagi District, this Court do not see any reason to differ from the rate of compensation awarded in MSA No.200101/2024.

Accordingly, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-K:9593 ORDER (1) Appeal is partly allowed.
(2) The compensation amount awarded by the Appellate court in a sum of Rs.4,38,036/- per acre with all statutory benefit is reduced to Rs.4,29,005/- per acre.
(3) It is made clear if there is any delay in claimants filing the appeal before the Appellate Court the said delayed period be excluded while calculating interest on the compensation.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending IA, if any, does not survive for consideration and same shall be disposed of.
